description: This file defines the JobServices class, which provides static methods for managing job-related operations in the Apache OFBiz framework. Operations include canceling jobs, canceling retries, purging old jobs, and resetting job states.

classes.name: JobServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for job management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job by updating its status and cancel timestamp based on the provided jobId.

methods.name: cancelJobRetries
methods.description: Sets the maximum retry count of a specified job to zero after permission verification.

methods.name: purgeOldJobs
methods.description: Removes jobs older than a certain number of days from a specified thread pool, based on configuration or defaults.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets the status and timestamps of a job to allow reprocessing, based on the provided jobId.
